summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a UI-component library but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-array + rotator + custom base-N decoder, hex-named identifiers) and unrelated to any UI-library functionality. The dropper script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with the same fingerprint. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque payload outside Node's normal introspection surface, at `npm install` time, is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and constitutes install-time remote code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
